audit_status.source_base: ChatGPT-authored Psalms completion draft using public-domain KJV as familiar alignment scaffold with curated Hebrew/textual overrides; full WLC/OSHB/source-witness audit pending
audit_status.review_note: Flood imagery, shame, zeal, enemies, poison/vinegar, imprecation, poor people, and praise.

verses.restored: Save me, O God; for the waters are come in to my soul.

familiar.text: Save me, O God; for the waters are come in unto my soul.

modern.text: Save me, O God, for the waters are up to my neck.

original.text: לַמְנַצֵּ֬חַ עַֽל שׁוֹשַׁנִּ֬ים לְדָוִֽד הוֹשִׁיעֵ֥נִי אֱלֹהִ֑ים כִּ֤י בָ֖אוּ מַ֣יִם עַד נָֽפֶשׁ

verses.restored: I sink in deep mire, where there is no standing: I am come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.

familiar.text: I sink in deep mire, where there is no standing: I am come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.

modern.text: I have sunk into the miry depths, where there is no footing; I have drifted into deep waters, where the flood engulfs me.

original.text: טָבַ֤עְתִּי בִּיוֵ֣ן מְ֭צוּלָה וְאֵ֣ין מָעֳמָ֑ד בָּ֥אתִי בְמַעֲמַקֵּי מַ֝֗יִם וְשִׁבֹּ֥לֶת שְׁטָפָֽתְנִי

verses.restored: I am weary of my crying: my throat is dried: mine eyes fail while I wait for my God.

familiar.text: I am weary of my crying: my throat is dried: mine eyes fail while I wait for my God.

modern.text: I am weary from my crying; my throat is parched. My eyes fail, looking for my God.

original.text: יָגַ֣עְתִּי בְקָרְאִי֮ נִחַ֪ר גְּר֫וֹנִ֥י כָּל֥וּ עֵינַ֑י מְ֝יַחֵ֗ל לֵאלֹהָֽי

verses.restored: They that hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of mine head: they that would destroy me, being mine enemies wrongfully, are mighty: then I restored that which I took not away.

familiar.text: They that hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of mine head: they that would destroy me, being mine enemies wrongfully, are mighty: then I restored that which I took not away.

modern.text: Those who hate me without cause outnumber the hairs of my head; many are those who would destroy me— my enemies for no reason. Though I did not steal, I must repay.

original.text: רַבּ֤וּ מִשַּׂעֲר֣וֹת רֹאשִׁי֮ שֹׂנְאַ֪י חִ֫נָּ֥ם עָצְמ֣וּ מַ֭צְמִיתַי אֹיְבַ֣י שֶׁ֑קֶר אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא גָ֝זַ֗לְתִּי אָ֣ז אָשִֽׁיב

verses.restored: O God, thou knowest my foolishness; and my sins are not hid from thee.

familiar.text: O God, thou knowest my foolishness; and my sins are not hid from thee.

modern.text: You know my folly, O God, and my guilt is not hidden from You.

original.text: אֱֽלֹהִ֗ים אַתָּ֣ה יָ֭דַעְתָּ לְאִוַּלְתִּ֑י וְ֝אַשְׁמוֹתַ֗י מִמְּךָ֥ לֹא נִכְחָֽדוּ

verses.restored: Let not them that wait on thee, O Lord GOD of hosts, be ashamed for my sake: let not those that seek thee be confounded for my sake, O God of Israel.

familiar.text: Let not them that wait on thee, O Lord GOD of hosts, be ashamed for my sake: let not those that seek thee be confounded for my sake, O God of Israel.

modern.text: May those who hope in You not be ashamed through me, O Lord GOD of Hosts; may those who seek You not be dishonored through me, O God of Israel.

original.text: אַל יֵ֘בֹ֤שׁוּ בִ֨י קֹוֶיךָ֮ אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִ֗ה צְבָ֫א֥וֹת אַל יִכָּ֣לְמוּ בִ֣י מְבַקְשֶׁ֑יךָ אֱ֝לֹהֵ֗י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: Because for thy sake I have borne reproach; shame hath covered my face.

familiar.text: Because for thy sake I have borne reproach; shame hath covered my face.

modern.text: For I have endured scorn for Your sake, and shame has covered my face.

original.text: כִּֽי עָ֭לֶיךָ נָשָׂ֣אתִי חֶרְפָּ֑ה כִּסְּתָ֖ה כְלִמָּ֣ה פָנָֽי

verses.restored: I am become a stranger to my brethren, and an alien to my mother’s children.

familiar.text: I am become a stranger unto my brethren, and an alien unto my mother’s children.

modern.text: I have become a stranger to my brothers and a foreigner to my mother’s sons,

original.text: מ֭וּזָר הָיִ֣יתִי לְאֶחָ֑י וְ֝נָכְרִ֗י לִבְנֵ֥י אִמִּֽי

verses.restored: For the zeal of thine house hath eaten me up; and the reproaches of them that reproached thee are fallen upon me.

familiar.text: For the zeal of thine house hath eaten me up; and the reproaches of them that reproached thee are fallen upon me.

modern.text: because zeal for Your house has consumed me, and the insults of those who insult You have fallen on me.

original.text: כִּֽי קִנְאַ֣ת בֵּיתְךָ֣ אֲכָלָ֑תְנִי וְחֶרְפּ֥וֹת ח֝וֹרְפֶ֗יךָ נָפְל֥וּ עָלָֽי

verses.restored: When I wept, and chastened my soul with fasting, that was to my reproach.

familiar.text: When I wept, and chastened my soul with fasting, that was to my reproach.

modern.text: I wept and fasted, but it brought me reproach.

original.text: וָאֶבְכֶּ֣ה בַצּ֣וֹם נַפְשִׁ֑י וַתְּהִ֖י לַחֲרָפ֣וֹת לִֽי

verses.restored: I made sackcloth also my garment; and I became a proverb to them.

familiar.text: I made sackcloth also my garment; and I became a proverb to them.

modern.text: I made sackcloth my clothing, and I was sport to them.

original.text: וָאֶתְּנָ֣ה לְבוּשִׁ֣י שָׂ֑ק וָאֱהִ֖י לָהֶ֣ם לְמָשָֽׁל

verses.restored: They that sit in the gate speak against me; and I was the song of the drunkards.

familiar.text: They that sit in the gate speak against me; and I was the song of the drunkards.

modern.text: Those who sit at the gate mock me, and I am the song of drunkards.

original.text: יָשִׂ֣יחוּ בִ֭י יֹ֣שְׁבֵי שָׁ֑עַר וּ֝נְגִינ֗וֹת שׁוֹתֵ֥י שֵׁכָֽר

verses.restored: But as for me, my prayer is to thee, O YHWH, in an acceptable time: O God, in the multitude of thy mercy hear me, in the truth of thy salvation.

familiar.text: But as for me, my prayer is unto thee, O LORD, in an acceptable time: O God, in the multitude of thy mercy hear me, in the truth of thy salvation.

modern.text: But my prayer to You, O LORD, is for a time of favor. In Your abundant loving devotion, O God, answer me with Your sure salvation.

original.text: וַאֲנִ֤י תְפִלָּתִֽי לְךָ֨ יְהוָ֡ה עֵ֤ת רָצ֗וֹן אֱלֹהִ֥ים בְּרָב חַסְדֶּ֑ךָ עֲ֝נֵ֗נִי בֶּאֱמֶ֥ת יִשְׁעֶֽךָ

verses.restored: Deliver me out of the mire, and let me not sink: let me be delivered from them that hate me, and out of the deep waters.

familiar.text: Deliver me out of the mire, and let me not sink: let me be delivered from them that hate me, and out of the deep waters.

modern.text: Rescue me from the mire and do not let me sink; deliver me from my foes and out of the deep waters.

original.text: הַצִּילֵ֣נִי מִ֭טִּיט וְאַל אֶטְבָּ֑עָה אִנָּצְלָ֥ה מִ֝שֹּֽׂנְאַ֗י וּמִמַּֽעֲמַקֵּי מָֽיִם

verses.restored: Let not the waterflood overflow me, neither let the deep swallow me up, and let not the pit shut her mouth upon me.

familiar.text: Let not the waterflood overflow me, neither let the deep swallow me up, and let not the pit shut her mouth upon me.

modern.text: Do not let the floods engulf me or the depths swallow me up; let not the Pit close its mouth over me.

original.text: אַל תִּשְׁטְפֵ֤נִי שִׁבֹּ֣לֶת מַ֭יִם וְאַל תִּבְלָעֵ֣נִי מְצוּלָ֑ה וְאַל תֶּאְטַר עָלַ֖י בְּאֵ֣ר פִּֽיהָ

verses.restored: Hear me, O YHWH; for thy lovingkindness is good: turn to me according to the multitude of thy tender mercies.

familiar.text: Hear me, O LORD; for thy lovingkindness is good: turn unto me according to the multitude of thy tender mercies.

modern.text: Answer me, O LORD, for Your loving devotion is good; turn to me in keeping with Your great compassion.

original.text: עֲנֵ֣נִי יְ֭הוָה כִּי ט֣וֹב חַסְדֶּ֑ךָ כְּרֹ֥ב רַ֝חֲמֶ֗יךָ פְּנֵ֣ה אֵלָֽי

verses.restored: And hide not thy face from thy servant; for I am in trouble: hear me speedily.

familiar.text: And hide not thy face from thy servant; for I am in trouble: hear me speedily.

modern.text: Hide not Your face from Your servant, for I am in distress. Answer me quickly!

original.text: וְאַל תַּסְתֵּ֣ר פָּ֭נֶיךָ מֵֽעַבְדֶּ֑ךָ כִּֽי צַר לִ֝֗י מַהֵ֥ר עֲנֵֽנִי

verses.restored: Draw nigh to my soul, and redeem it: deliver me because of mine enemies.

familiar.text: Draw nigh unto my soul, and redeem it: deliver me because of mine enemies.

modern.text: Draw near to my soul and redeem me; ransom me because of my foes.

original.text: קָרְבָ֣ה אֶל נַפְשִׁ֣י גְאָלָ֑הּ לְמַ֖עַן אֹיְבַ֣י פְּדֵֽנִי

verses.restored: Thou hast known my reproach, and my shame, and my dishonour: mine adversaries are all before thee.

familiar.text: Thou hast known my reproach, and my shame, and my dishonour: mine adversaries are all before thee.

modern.text: You know my reproach, my shame and disgrace. All my adversaries are before You.

original.text: אַתָּ֤ה יָדַ֗עְתָּ חֶרְפָּתִ֣י וּ֭בָשְׁתִּי וּכְלִמָּתִ֑י נֶ֝גְדְּךָ֗ כָּל צוֹרְרָֽי

verses.restored: Reproach hath broken my heart; and I am full of heaviness: and I looked for some to take pity, but there was none; and for comforters, but I found none.

familiar.text: Reproach hath broken my heart; and I am full of heaviness: and I looked for some to take pity, but there was none; and for comforters, but I found none.

modern.text: Insults have broken my heart, and I am in despair. I looked for sympathy, but there was none, for comforters, but I found no one.

original.text: חֶרְפָּ֤ה שָֽׁבְרָ֥ה לִבִּ֗י וָֽאָ֫נ֥וּשָׁה וָאֲקַוֶּ֣ה לָנ֣וּד וָאַ֑יִן וְ֝לַמְנַחֲמִ֗ים וְלֹ֣א מָצָֽאתִי

verses.restored: They gave me poison for food, and for my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.

familiar.text: They gave me also gall for my meat; and in my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.

notes.title: Poison and vinegar
notes.body: This lament later shaped Gospel passion narratives. Its original setting remains a Jewish sufferer’s prayer and should not be erased by later Christian reception.

modern.text: They poisoned my food with gall and gave me vinegar to quench my thirst.

original.text: וַיִּתְּנ֣וּ בְּבָרוּתִ֣י רֹ֑אשׁ וְ֝לִצְמָאִ֗י יַשְׁק֥וּנִי חֹֽמֶץ

verses.restored: Let their table become a snare before them: and that which should have been for their welfare, let it become a trap.

familiar.text: Let their table become a snare before them: and that which should have been for their welfare, let it become a trap.

modern.text: May their table become a snare; may it be a retribution and a trap.

original.text: יְהִֽי שֻׁלְחָנָ֣ם לִפְנֵיהֶ֣ם לְפָ֑ח וְלִשְׁלוֹמִ֥ים לְמוֹקֵֽשׁ

verses.restored: Let their eyes be darkened, that they see not; and make their loins continually to shake.

familiar.text: Let their eyes be darkened, that they see not; and make their loins continually to shake.

modern.text: May their eyes be darkened so they cannot see, and their backs be bent forever.

original.text: תֶּחְשַׁ֣כְנָה עֵ֭ינֵיהֶם מֵרְא֑וֹת וּ֝מָתְנֵ֗יהֶם תָּמִ֥יד הַמְעַֽד

verses.restored: Pour out thine indignation upon them, and let thy wrathful anger take hold of them.

familiar.text: Pour out thine indignation upon them, and let thy wrathful anger take hold of them.

modern.text: Pour out Your wrath upon them, and let Your burning anger overtake them.

original.text: שְׁפָךְ עֲלֵיהֶ֥ם זַעְמֶ֑ךָ וַחֲר֥וֹן אַ֝פְּךָ֗ יַשִּׂיגֵֽם

verses.restored: Let their habitation be desolate; and let none dwell in their tents.

familiar.text: Let their habitation be desolate; and let none dwell in their tents.

modern.text: May their place be deserted; let there be no one to dwell in their tents.

original.text: תְּהִי טִֽירָתָ֥ם נְשַׁמָּ֑ה בְּ֝אָהֳלֵיהֶ֗ם אַל יְהִ֥י יֹשֵֽׁב

verses.restored: For they persecute him whom thou hast smitten; and they talk to the grief of those whom thou hast wounded.

familiar.text: For they persecute him whom thou hast smitten; and they talk to the grief of those whom thou hast wounded.

modern.text: For they persecute the one You struck and recount the pain of those You wounded.

original.text: כִּֽי אַתָּ֣ה אֲשֶׁר הִכִּ֣יתָ רָדָ֑פוּ וְאֶל מַכְא֖וֹב חֲלָלֶ֣יךָ יְסַפֵּֽרוּ

verses.restored: Add iniquity to their iniquity: and let them not come into thy righteousness.

familiar.text: Add iniquity unto their iniquity: and let them not come into thy righteousness.

modern.text: Add iniquity to their iniquity; let them not share in Your righteousness.

original.text: תְּֽנָה עָ֭וֺן עַל עֲוֺנָ֑ם וְאַל יָ֝בֹ֗אוּ בְּצִדְקָתֶֽךָ

verses.restored: Let them be blotted out of the book of the living, and not be written with the righteous.

familiar.text: Let them be blotted out of the book of the living, and not be written with the righteous.

modern.text: May they be blotted out of the Book of Life and not listed with the righteous.

original.text: יִ֭מָּחֽוּ מִסֵּ֣פֶר חַיִּ֑ים וְעִ֥ם צַ֝דִּיקִ֗ים אַל יִכָּתֵֽבוּ

verses.restored: But I am poor and sorrowful: let thy salvation, O God, set me up on high.

familiar.text: But I am poor and sorrowful: let thy salvation, O God, set me up on high.

modern.text: But I am in pain and distress; let Your salvation protect me, O God.

original.text: וַ֭אֲנִי עָנִ֣י וְכוֹאֵ֑ב יְשׁוּעָתְךָ֖ אֱלֹהִ֣ים תְּשַׂגְּבֵֽנִי

verses.restored: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.

familiar.text: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.

modern.text: I will praise God’s name in song and exalt Him with thanksgiving.

original.text: אֲהַֽלְלָ֣ה שֵׁם אֱלֹהִ֣ים בְּשִׁ֑יר וַאֲגַדְּלֶ֥נּוּ בְתוֹדָֽה

verses.restored: This also shall please YHWH better than an ox or bullock that hath horns and hoofs.

familiar.text: This also shall please the LORD better than an ox or bullock that hath horns and hoofs.

modern.text: And this will please the LORD more than an ox, more than a bull with horns and hooves.

original.text: וְתִיטַ֣ב לַֽ֭יהוָה מִשּׁ֥וֹר פָּ֗ר מַקְרִ֥ן מַפְרִֽיס

verses.restored: The humble shall see this, and be glad: and your heart shall live that seek God.

familiar.text: The humble shall see this, and be glad: and your heart shall live that seek God.

modern.text: The humble will see and rejoice. You who seek God, let your hearts be revived!

original.text: רָא֣וּ עֲנָוִ֣ים יִשְׂמָ֑חוּ דֹּרְשֵׁ֥י אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים וִיחִ֥י לְבַבְכֶֽם

verses.restored: For YHWH heareth the poor, and despiseth not his prisoners.

familiar.text: For the LORD heareth the poor, and despiseth not his prisoners.

modern.text: For the LORD listens to the needy and does not despise His captive people.

original.text: כִּֽי שֹׁמֵ֣עַ אֶל אֶבְיוֹנִ֣ים יְהוָ֑ה וְאֶת אֲ֝סִירָ֗יו לֹ֣א בָזָֽה

verses.restored: Let the heaven and earth praise him, the seas, and every thing that moveth therein.

familiar.text: Let the heaven and earth praise him, the seas, and every thing that moveth therein.

modern.text: Let heaven and earth praise Him, the seas and everything that moves in them.

original.text: יְֽ֭הַלְלוּהוּ שָׁמַ֣יִם וָאָ֑רֶץ יַ֝מִּ֗ים וְֽכָל רֹמֵ֥שׂ בָּֽם

verses.restored: For God will save Zion, and will build the cities of Judah: that they may dwell there, and have it in possession.

familiar.text: For God will save Zion, and will build the cities of Judah: that they may dwell there, and have it in possession.

modern.text: For God will save Zion and rebuild the cities of Judah, that they may dwell there and possess it.

original.text: כִּ֤י אֱלֹהִ֨ים י֘וֹשִׁ֤יעַ צִיּ֗וֹן וְ֭יִבְנֶה עָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה וְיָ֥שְׁבוּ שָׁ֝֗ם וִירֵשֽׁוּהָ

verses.restored: The seed also of his servants shall inherit it: and they that love his name shall dwell therein.

familiar.text: The seed also of his servants shall inherit it: and they that love his name shall dwell therein.

modern.text: The descendants of His servants will inherit it, and those who love His name will settle in it.

original.text: וְזֶ֣רַע עֲ֭בָדָיו יִנְחָל֑וּהָ וְאֹהֲבֵ֥י שְׁ֝מ֗וֹ יִשְׁכְּנוּ בָֽהּ

translation_notes: This chapter completes corpus coverage as a ChatGPT-authored draft. KJV is retained as a familiar comparison layer; a separate automated reference pass adds BSB and pointed Hebrew without replacing the restored draft.
safety_note: Extreme curses remain lament language, not permission for revenge. Later Christian reception must not erase the psalm’s Jewish voice.
source_witness_audit_flags: Compare directly with WLC/OSHB, Septuagint, Dead Sea Psalms witnesses where extant, and other textual witnesses during the global audit. Preserve poetic parallelism, superscriptions, duplicate/parallel psalms, and significant Hebrew/Greek divergences rather than harmonizing them.
